```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(zoo)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggthemes)

Proc <- here("data", "processed")
raw  <- here("data", "raw")
figs <- here("figures")
out  <- here("output")

dir.create(figs, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out,  showWarnings = FALSE)

# Load analysis panel and spatial data
analysis_panel <- readRDS(file.path(Proc, "analysis_panel.rds"))
study_sf       <- readRDS(file.path(Proc, "study_sf.rds"))

message("Panel loaded: ", nrow(analysis_panel), " rows | ",
        n_distinct(analysis_panel$ons_code), " study units")
```

```{r}
#| label: summary-stats
#| message: false

# Summary statistics by group 
summary_stats <- analysis_panel |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    filter(yq == as.yearqtr("2022 Q3")) |> # pre-announcement snapshot
    mutate(
        group = case_when(
            london == 1 & treated == 0 ~ "Inner London (2019/2021 treated)",
            london == 1 & treated == 1 ~ "Outer London (2023 treated)",
            london == 0 ~ "Surrounding Districts"
        )
    ) |>
    group_by(group) |>
    summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_ulev_share = mean(ulev_share, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_cars_total = mean(cars_total, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_pct_no_car = mean(pct_no_car, na.rm=TRUE),
        mean_deprivation = mean(deprivation_index, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_pop_density = mean(pop_density_per_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_house_price = mean(house_price, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_earnings = mean(median_earnings_gbp, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )
saveRDS(summary_stats, file.path(out, "summary_stats.rds"))   # APPENDIX

summary_stats |>
    kable(
        digits  = 3,
        caption = "Summary Statistics by Group — Pre-Announcement (2022 Q3)",
        col.names = c("Group", "N", "ULEV Share", "Total Cars",
                      "% No Car", "Deprivation Index", "Pop Density /km²",
                      "Avg House Price", "Median Earnings"),
        booktabs = TRUE
    ) |>
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position", "scale_down"))
```

```{r}
#| label: raw-trends
#| message: false

# Aggregate to group means by quarter
trends_data <- analysis_panel |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    mutate(
        group = case_when(
            london == 1 & treated == 0 ~ "Inner London (2019/2021 treated)",
            london == 1 & treated == 1 ~ "Outer London (2023 treated)",
            london == 0                ~ "Surrounding Districts (never treated)"
        )
    ) |>
    group_by(yq, group) |>
    summarise(
        mean_ulev_share = mean(ulev_share, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

p_raw_trends <- ggplot(trends_data,
                       aes(x = yq, y = mean_ulev_share, colour = group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(as.yearqtr("2022 Q4")),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(as.yearqtr("2023 Q3")),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("text", x = as.numeric(as.yearqtr("2022 Q4")),
             y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1,
             label = "Announcement", size = 3, colour = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = as.numeric(as.yearqtr("2023 Q3")),
             y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1,
             label = "Implementation", size = 3, colour = "red") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
        "Inner London (2019/2021 treated)"      = "steelblue",
        "Outer London (2023 treated)"           = "firebrick",
        "Surrounding Districts (never treated)" = "darkgreen"
    )) +
    labs(
        title    = "ULEV Compliance Share by Group",
        subtitle = "Mean across study units by quarter",
        x        = "Quarter",
        y        = "ULEV share (ULEVs / total cars)",
        colour   = NULL,
        caption  = "Black dashed = 2023 announcement (2022 Q4). Red dashed = implementation (2023 Q3)."
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file.path(figs, "raw_trends.png"), p_raw_trends,     # APPENDIX
       width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

p_raw_trends
```

```{r}
#| label: study-area-map
#| message: false

study_sf <- study_sf |>
    mutate(london = as.integer(str_starts(ons_code, "E09")))

# Load ULEZ boundaries for the map
ulez_2021 <- st_read(
    file.path(raw, "ulez_2021/InnerUltraLowEmissionZone.shp"),
    quiet = TRUE
) |>
    st_set_crs(27700)

ulez_2023 <- st_read(
    file.path(raw, "ulez_2023/londonWideUltraLowEmissionZone.shp"),
    quiet = TRUE
) |>
    st_set_crs(27700)

# Map
p_map <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = study_sf |> filter(london == 0),
            fill = "lightyellow", colour = "orange",
            linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_sf(data = study_sf |> filter(london == 1, treated == 1),
            fill = "#f4a582", colour = "grey50",
            linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = study_sf |> filter(london == 1, treated == 0),
            fill = "#92c5de", colour = "grey50",
            linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = ulez_2021, fill = NA, colour = "darkblue",
            linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_sf(data = ulez_2023, fill = NA, colour = "darkred",
            linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
        title    = NULL,
        subtitle = NULL,
        caption  = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        axis.text  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()
    )

ggsave(file.path(figs, "study_area_map.png"), p_map,        # SECTION 2
       width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)

p_map
```

```{r}
#| label: balance-table
#| message: false

# Donor and treated pools, matching the definitions in Notebook 3
treated_2019 <- analysis_panel |> st_drop_geometry() |>
    filter(london == 1, rv_2019 < 0) |> distinct(la_name) |> pull(la_name)
donor_2019   <- analysis_panel |> st_drop_geometry() |>
    filter(london == 0 | (rv_2019 > 0 & rv_2021 > 0)) |>
    distinct(la_name) |> pull(la_name)

treated_2021 <- analysis_panel |> st_drop_geometry() |>
    filter(london == 1, rv_2021 < 0, rv_2019 > 0) |>
    distinct(la_name) |> pull(la_name)
donor_2021   <- analysis_panel |> st_drop_geometry() |>
    filter(rv_2021 > 0 | london == 0) |> distinct(la_name) |> pull(la_name)

treated_2023 <- analysis_panel |> st_drop_geometry() |>
    filter(london == 1, treated == 1) |> distinct(la_name) |> pull(la_name)
donor_2023   <- analysis_panel |> st_drop_geometry() |>
    filter(london == 0) |> distinct(la_name) |> pull(la_name)

# Each wave compared at its own pre-announcement quarter against its own pool
balance_wave <- function(panel, treated_units, donor_units, snapshot, wave) {
    panel |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        filter(yq == as.yearqtr(snapshot),
               la_name %in% c(treated_units, donor_units)) |>
        mutate(role = if_else(la_name %in% treated_units, "Treated", "Donors")) |>
        group_by(role) |>
        summarise(
            `N units`               = n(),
            `ULEV share (%)`        = mean(ulev_share, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
            `Cars per household`    = mean(avg_cars_hh, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Deprivation index`     = mean(deprivation_index, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Pop density (per km2)` = mean(pop_density_per_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Median earnings (GBP)` = mean(median_earnings_gbp, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop"
        ) |>
        mutate(col = paste0(wave, " ", role)) |>
        select(-role) |>
        pivot_longer(-col, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "value")
}

# Per-variable formatting applied before the pivot, so mixed precision does
# not survive into the printed table (N units as integers, shares to 2dp).
balance_all <- bind_rows(
    balance_wave(analysis_panel, treated_2019, donor_2019, "2017 Q1", "2019"),
    balance_wave(analysis_panel, treated_2021, donor_2021, "2018 Q1", "2021"),
    balance_wave(analysis_panel, treated_2023, donor_2023, "2022 Q3", "2023")
) |>
    mutate(value = case_when(
        Variable == "N units"               ~ format(round(value)),
        Variable == "ULEV share (%)"        ~ sprintf("%.2f", value),
        Variable == "Cars per household"    ~ sprintf("%.2f", value),
        Variable == "Deprivation index"     ~ sprintf("%.3f", value),
        Variable == "Pop density (per km2)" ~ format(round(value), big.mark = ","),
        Variable == "Median earnings (GBP)" ~ format(round(value), big.mark = ",")
    )) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = value) |>
    select(Variable,
           `2019 Treated`, `2019 Donors`,
           `2021 Treated`, `2021 Donors`,
           `2023 Treated`, `2023 Donors`)

saveRDS(balance_all, file.path(out, "balance_all.rds"))     # SECTION 4.1

balance_all |>
    kable(
        caption  = "Pre-Announcement Characteristics by Wave",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        align    = c("l", rep("r", 6))
    ) |>
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position", "scale_down")) |>
    add_footnote(
        paste("The 2019 and 2021 waves share a donor pool of 38 units by",
              "construction, so time-invariant donor characteristics are",
              "identical across those columns."),
        notation = "none"
    )
```

```{r}
#| label: disaggregated-trends
#| message: false

# Aggregate disaggregated shares by group and quarter
disagg_data <- analysis_panel |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    mutate(
        group = case_when(
            london == 1 & treated == 0 ~ "Inner London (2019/2021 treated)",
            london == 1 & treated == 1 ~ "Outer London (2023 treated)",
            london == 0                ~ "Surrounding Districts"
        )
    ) |>
    group_by(yq, group) |>
    summarise(
        mean_bev_share     = mean(bev_share,     na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_phev_share    = mean(phev_share,    na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_company_share = mean(company_share, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_private_share = mean(private_share, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

# BEV vs PHEV
p1 <- disagg_data |>
    pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_bev_share, mean_phev_share),
                 names_to = "fuel_type",
                 values_to = "share") |>
    mutate(fuel_type = recode(fuel_type,
                              "mean_bev_share"  = "BEV",
                              "mean_phev_share" = "PHEV")) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = yq, y = share, colour = group, linetype = fuel_type)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(as.yearqtr("2022 Q4")),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(as.yearqtr("2023 Q3")),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
        "Inner London (2019/2021 treated)" = "steelblue",
        "Outer London (2023 treated)"      = "firebrick",
        "Surrounding Districts"            = "darkgreen"
    )) +
    labs(
        title    = "BEV vs PHEV Share by Group",
        x        = "Quarter",
        y        = "Share of total cars",
        colour   = NULL,
        linetype = "Fuel type"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Company vs Private
p2 <- disagg_data |>
    pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_company_share, mean_private_share),
                 names_to = "keepership",
                 values_to = "share") |>
    mutate(keepership = recode(keepership,
                               "mean_company_share" = "Company",
                               "mean_private_share" = "Private")) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = yq, y = share, colour = group, linetype = keepership)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(as.yearqtr("2022 Q4")),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(as.yearqtr("2023 Q3")),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
        "Inner London (2019/2021 treated)" = "steelblue",
        "Outer London (2023 treated)"      = "firebrick",
        "Surrounding Districts"            = "darkgreen"
    )) +
    labs(
        title    = "Company vs Private ULEV Share by Group",
        x        = "Quarter",
        y        = "Share of keepership-specific cars",
        colour   = NULL,
        linetype = "Keepership"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

library(patchwork)

# Saved separately: the keepership panel carries the Section 7 finding,
# the fuel-type panel is supporting material.
ggsave(file.path(figs, "disagg_fuel.png"), p1,              # APPENDIX
       width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(figs, "disagg_keepership.png"), p2,        # SECTION 7
       width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

p1 / p2
```
